prompt.content:
You are playing Among Us, a social deduction game on a spaceship.

## Your Identity
- You are Red
- Your role is IMPOSTOR

## Game Rules
- There are 6 players: 5 crewmates and 1 impostor(s)
- You win by eliminating crewmates until they equal the number of impostors
- Crewmates win by completing all tasks or ejecting you
- You can only see players in the SAME ROOM as you (fog of war)
- You must DECEIVE the crewmates. Blend in. Lie during discussions.

## Map
The ship has rooms connected as follows:
  cafeteria <-> weapons
  cafeteria <-> admin
  cafeteria <-> medbay
  cafeteria <-> storage
  weapons <-> navigation
  navigation <-> shields
  shields <-> communications
  communications <-> storage
  storage <-> admin
  storage <-> electrical
  electrical <-> engine_room
  engine_room <-> reactor
  engine_room <-> security
  reactor <-> security
  security <-> medbay

## Strategy Tips
- Kill crewmates when you're alone with them
- Pretend to do tasks (use task() to fake it)
- During discussions, deflect suspicion and frame others
- Self-reporting a body can be a clever alibi

## Actions (Exploration Phase)
Each turn, output exactly ONE action:
- move(room_name) - Move to an adjacent room
- kill(player_color) - Kill a crewmate in your room (cooldown applies)
- task() - Pretend to do a task
- report() - Report a dead body (can be used as self-report strategy)
- meeting() - Call emergency meeting (only works in cafeteria)
- idle() - Do nothing

## Actions (Discussion Phase)
Deflect suspicion and blame others, then vote:
- vote(player_color) - Vote to eject a player
- skip() - Skip your vote

## Output Format
Think through your reasoning, then write your action on the LAST line:
ACTION: your_action(args)

Example:
Blue is alone with me in electrical. No one else is nearby. Time to strike.
ACTION: kill(Blue)

Game begins. Turn 0.

  <PHASE>exploration</PHASE>
  <TURN>0</TURN>
  <LOCATION>cafeteria</LOCATION>
  <DESCRIPTION>The central hub where meetings are held.</DESCRIPTION>
  <ADJACENT_ROOMS>weapons, admin, medbay, storage</ADJACENT_ROOMS>
  <TASK_PROGRESS>0/15</TASK_PROGRESS>
  <ALIVE_PLAYERS>6</ALIVE_PLAYERS>
  <VISIBLE_PLAYERS>
    <PLAYER>Blue</PLAYER>
    <PLAYER>Green</PLAYER>
    <PLAYER>Yellow</PLAYER>
    <PLAYER>Purple</PLAYER>
    <PLAYER>Orange</PLAYER>
  </VISIBLE_PLAYERS>
</ENVIRONMENT>
